text:
Lina (product): Customer: Meridian Health wants a phased private deploy roadmap that keeps tenant IPs stable during upgrades and gives NetOps a deterministic rollback. They also require KMS + audit logs. Need proposal by EOW.
Ken (eng-runtime): High-level split: Slice 1 = managed BGP peering, DNS handoff automation, canary promotions, rollback playbook. Slice 2 = IP continuity (VIP transfer / floating IPs) and airgapped installer. Slice 1 ~ 2-3w, Slice 2 ~ 5-7w.
Sofia (field): Meridian accepts a short maintenance window if we keep packet loss <= 30s and provide test harness. They prefer VIP transfer over full IP reassign.
Alex (solutions): Recommend a "VIP graceful-swap" flow: warm backend caches, mirror traffic, then switch VIP using BGP withdraw/announce. We can provide scripts/responses for verification.
Ken (eng-runtime): Implementation note: need a control-plane operation to sequence cache warm, health checks, and VIP announcement. Add flag: "vip_swap_strategy": "mirror-first|immediate". We'll also need to document manual rollback steps.
Lina (product): Proposed target: Q3 ship Slice 1 (BGP peering, DNS automation, canary API, runbook, audit logs). Slice 2 (IP continuity + offline installer) on Q4. Align SLA language with legal.
deploy-bot: Runbook created: /docs/private-deploys/meridian-handshake.md. Owner: Alex. Reviewers: Ken, Sofia.
Sofia (field): Meridian also asked for a cost estimate for reserved capacity during canary windows. I'll coordinate with finance and add to the runbook.
Ken (eng-runtime): I'll open RFC for installer extension to accept customer VIPs and BGP communities. Prototyping vip_swap_strategy toggles this sprint.
Alex (solutions): I'll prepare the harness and sample commands: ```
# verify canary
curl -H "Host: meridian-canary" https://private.meridian/health
# promote
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/promote -d '{"tenant":"meridian-canary"}'
```
Lina (product): Action items: Alex runbook + harness by Tue, Ken RFC + basic prototype by Thu, Sofia confirm Meridian SLAs and cost constraints by Wed. We'll present slice plan at Friday steering.
